# Movement and school geometry

Fish trajectories contain an ordered sequence of **observed** positions. A path's measured length is therefore a *supported observed distance*, not necessarily the animal's true distance traveled through occlusions.

## Core movement analysis

```r
library(aquaTrajectories)
set.seed(34)
tracks <- aqt_simulate_tracks(n_fish = 5, n_frames = 200)
kin <- aqt_kinematics(tracks, max_gap_s = 0.1)
paths <- aqt_path_summary(tracks, max_gap_s = 0.1)
school <- aqt_group_metrics(tracks, max_gap_s = 0.1)
aqt_plot_paths(tracks)
```

The simulated paths above are not real fish. In actual video analysis, annotate skipped frames, variable PTS and long support gaps explicitly.

## Spatial group metrics

- [`aqt_group_pairwise_distances()`](../reference/aqt_group_pairwise_distances.html): simultaneous observed pairwise fish positions.
- [`aqt_group_spatial_summary()`](../reference/aqt_group_spatial_summary.html): geometry and group spatial spread.
- [`aqt_group_spatial_edges()`](../reference/aqt_group_spatial_edges.html): threshold-defined proximity networks, **not** inferred friendships or dominance.
- [`aqt_zone_occupancy()`](../reference/aqt_zone_occupancy.html): user-defined observed 2D zones.
- [`aqt_voxel_occupancy()`](../reference/aqt_voxel_occupancy.html): observed 3D voxel occupancy, when physical XYZ is valid.
- [`aqt_voxel_entropy()`](../reference/aqt_voxel_entropy.html): conditional occupancy entropy over declared cells.

## Path shape and recurrence

[`aqt_trajectory_dtw()`](../reference/aqt_trajectory_dtw.html) and [`aqt_trajectory_dtw_matrix()`](../reference/aqt_trajectory_dtw_matrix.html) compute time-warped distances under declared assumptions. [`aqt_trajectory_recurrence()`](../reference/aqt_trajectory_recurrence.html) quantifies observed-position recurrence with radius and temporal exclusion rules.

Dense-grid principal components appear in [`aqt_trajectory_grid_pca()`](../reference/aqt_trajectory_grid_pca.html). Irregular sparse sampling is a separate estimation problem handled in [`aqt_sparse_fpca_fit()`](../reference/aqt_sparse_fpca_fit.html) where `fdapace` is available.

## Visual displays

Find [`aqt_plot_paths()`](../reference/aqt_plot_paths.html), [`aqt_plot_school_dynamics()`](../reference/aqt_plot_school_dynamics.html), [`aqt_plot_school3d()`](../reference/aqt_plot_school3d.html) and [`aqt_plot_voxel3d()`](../reference/aqt_plot_voxel3d.html) in the visualization reference.

Proximity alone is not evidence of leadership, preference, stress or positive welfare.

See [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/SCHOOL_SPATIAL_METHODS.md) and [source protocol](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/docs/FUNCTIONAL_TRAJECTORY_METHODS.md).
